				<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">phya pa</rs></note> ni gzhan sel phyin ci ma log pa sgra'i rnam pa can gyi rtog pa'i zhen du yin ces 'dod te don mthun ces gsung ngo || </seg></TEI>
